content.text:
**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **§ 8.2** — Automatic renewals are for successive **twelve-month** periods (not multi-year), and Customer can opt out on **30 days'** written notice, meeting the preferred ≤30-day window. Vendor must send a **60-day** renewal reminder, and a missed reminder extends our opt-out deadline — an extra customer-favourable mechanic.
- **§ 8.3** — Renewal uplift is capped at the **lesser of CPI and 3%**, exactly the preferred cap, with 90 days' notice of any increase and no increase on prepaid periods.
- **§ 8.1** — The fixed three-year initial term is a negotiated initial commitment, not an automatic multi-year renewal, so the walk-away trigger is not engaged.
